sanskrit_verse:
सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव गुणास्तस्यैव कीर्तिताः ।
रजस्तमोभ्यामाविष्टश्चक्रवद्भ्राम्यते ह्यसौ ॥३.१८२
transliteration: sattvaṃ rajas tamaś caiva guṇās tasyaiva kīrtitāḥ | rajastamobhyām āviṣṭaś cakravad bhrāmyate hy asau ||3.182||
sph_interpretive_translation: The three guṇas—sattva, rajas, and tamas—are declared as the inherent qualities of Prakṛti; when the jīva is overwhelmed by rajas and tamas, it revolves perpetually like a wheel.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in the sovereign clarity of sattva-guṇa, not in reactive or inert states
Causation arises through guṇic dominance, determining the field of action
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by guṇic alignment rather than moral fault
Restoration logic operates through elevation of guṇic state, not punitive suppression
Consciousness alignment occurs via purification of guṇic influence
